Acceptance criteria describe externally observable, inspectable facts rather than vague intent: fixed schema shapes and rejected/accepted fixtures (AC-001..006), byte-identical output comparisons and ordered trigger lists (AC-007..009), an exact five-target payload-file-set equality check (AC-010, AC-031), specific VERDICT/Status transitions keyed to specific field values (AC-011, AC-012, AC-026, AC-030), and concrete exit-code/message-shape/non-overridability properties (AC-019, AC-027, AC-028). Each is checkable by a future automated fixture or, for the design-content-review class (AC-020, AC-022, AC-029; acceptance-tests.md:56-110), by direct inspection of design.md/requirements.md text, matching the same class of review sibling epics A4/A5 already use (acceptance-tests.md:61-64, 135-138).

The Non-goals section (requirements.md:668-742) is explicit and enumerates concrete exclusions where the feature could otherwise expand: no edits to contracts/**, plugins/**, scripts/**, tests/**, .github/**, docs/** in this Phase 1 commit; no reimplementation of A5's workflow-combination-invalid Block, A2's evaluate-predicate, A3's resolve-component-paths, or A5's Resolver pipeline; a fixed three-token lite-check-catalog seed with no larger invented vocabulary; no touching generate-gate-capabilities; no unilateral expansion of the protected-file inventory; and explicit exclusion of sdd-delivery/Artifact Gate/Promotion Gate. Roles and Permissions (requirements.md:923-934) additionally states the author commit touches only specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/** plus two registration files (AC-023).

Material constraints are stated explicitly: a dedicated Security Boundaries section (requirements.md:1106-1143) names the fail-closed posture for every failure mode (unrecognized catalog token, schema-invalid Summary, absent Summary under active enforcement, full_upgrade_required:true, unmapped check-id, supplied-but-invalid capability-reasons fragment) and the single legitimate degrade path (total absence of --capability-reasons). Migration/compatibility constraints are stated (REQ-001 item 3, requirements.md:282-296; Edge Cases 'v1 Registry, field absent entirely,' requirements.md:1022-1039). Protected-file/human-copy approval-boundary constraints are named per REQ (REQ-002/REQ-005, requirements.md:413-420, 597-601) with a citable, evidence-bound Amendment Re-Review Context (investigation.md:696-777) satisfying the calibration's full evidence bar (full, unabbreviated amendment commit hashes; per-document SHA-256 as of each amendment commit; a verbatim, dated human-approval quotation; and commit/SHA-256 citations for every later-phase artifact referenced by the amended text), so the Overview's dated note (requirements.md:47-58) inherits cited evidence rather than standing as a bare assertion, resolving the round-2 CONSTRAINTS-EXPLICIT finding the precheck edit summary names.

The Risks section (requirements.md:1200-1243) names four risk claims and each has a planned validation surface: A5-not-yet-Passed is tied to AC-029/TEST-029 (requirements.md:801; acceptance-tests.md:52, 87-110), which states explicitly this becomes normative once A5's own addendum lands; the intake-time-Block-is-not-sole-enforcement risk is covered by the already-mandatory ship-time recheck (Main Workflows step 6, requirements.md:1012-1018); the eleven-category-to-token mapping risk is covered by AC-004/TEST-004's catalog-growth lock (requirements.md:776; acceptance-tests.md:29) and is explicitly flagged for a future spec-review pass; the lite-check-catalog seed-narrowness risk is covered by AC-003/TEST-003 (requirements.md:775; acceptance-tests.md:28) and the catalog's own additive-versioning mechanism.
